comments: c32a5e70: This section of the code is for initializing and setting up the report generation process for outpatient records.
4e918839: Check if multiple divisions exist and prompt the user to select a division if so.
ba5b32bb: If there are not multiple divisions, automatically select the first division available.
eb23d0bd: Execute the report generation command based on the type of report requested.
63631bf7: Prompt the user to specify the date range for which the report should be generated.
6ab1d8e7: Set a filter to only include certain types of summaries in the report.
e5c5ac91: Prompt the user to select which summary types to include in the report.
fc928805: Inform the user that the output format of this report requires a wider screen or printer setting.
e191144e: Get the current date and time to include as part of the report header.
d716fabb: Prepare the necessary variables for report generation and proceed with the task if the device is ready.
e3024709: Exit the routine and perform any necessary cleanup operations.
4cb56e0b: Begin iterating through the records in preparation for generating the report.
9d5145a1: Check if there are records to process for a detailed report and proceed if there are.
b703b32d: Check if there are records for a summary report and proceed to the appropriate module if so.
961bb1f8: Display a message indicating that no records were found if applicable.
a66c7603: Terminate the report generation process and exit.
9cb4e7c0: Calculate and update counters for records that are over a certain threshold.
5493fff8: Increment the division's total records counter and, if applicable, the counter for records exceeding a specific time frame.
adda6316: For physician-related reports, update the total and over-time counters specific to each physician.
56bfadf4: Invoke the PC subroutine to process counts related to physician records.
f5430412: For service-related reports, update the total and over-time counters specific to each service and call PC for further processing.
f0e38ddc: Update the total counters for specialties within a service.
a030d84d: Conclude the current subroutine and return to the calling process.
51213538: Verify that the division is included in the user's selection before proceeding.
19f818e4: Ensure the current record's division matches the selected division for processing.
d16bf1d0: Exclude records from the summary report if they do not meet the specified criteria.
b5c89b56: Exclude records from the discharge report if they are not discharge summaries.
4c9c9f30: Exclude discharge summaries that do not have a corresponding admission record.
167f0529: Assign a value based on the report type to determine the length of the service or physician name.
b35987f5: Exclude records that do not match the specified summary types from the report.
042d8adc: Exclude records based on nurse assignment as specified by the user's selection.
f9a8bf2b: Exclude records based on the team assignment as specified by the user's selection.
14b06133: Filter out records that do not match the selected summary types for inclusion in the report.
c84af552: Exclude records that fall outside the specified date range for the report.
584b1336: Load report data for each applicable record, skipping those that do not meet the criteria.
b67bc0eb: Set the division name for the record, defaulting to 'NOT SPECIFIED' if the division cannot be determined.
0e4d80b9: For service reports, ensure the division name is within a specific length and initialize total counters if necessary.
c193154f: Retrieve and set the patient's name from their record for inclusion in the report.
8e7acced: For physician reports, set the physician's name, record the data, and update count totals.
750e71ee: For service reports, determine the service and specialty names, and prepare the data for recording.
62d51f96: Adjust names for service reports to fit within specified lengths and record the data along with count totals.
0ba7fb44: Exit the current checking subroutine and return control to the calling process.
da0a2ea6: Aggregate counts for processing and updating total counters for either physicians or services.
bda7c2ac: Update aggregated counts for physicians, reflecting the latest data.
af28571e: Update aggregated counts for services, reflecting the latest data.
4e9eefd7: Conclude the count processing subroutine and return to the main process.
102e4cea: Calculate and update total and over-threshold counters for either physician or service reports.
477d1f58: Conclude the total count updating subroutine and return to the main process.
2cbef471: Initiate the process for selecting physicians to include in the report, setting a flag if cancelled.
bea1dd8d: Terminate the physician selection process and return to the main flow.
61d9a2ca: Begin the service selection process, allowing the user to specify which services to include in the report.
fb455f40: Following service selection, prompt the user to select specific specialties for inclusion in the report.
55a3b839: Conclude the service and specialty selection process and return to the main report generation flow.
